fertilizers.name: Urea
fertilizers.application_method: Broadcast or Band placement (છંટકાવ અથવા પટ્ટીમાં)
fertilizers.timing: Split 3 histo: Vavani, 30 din, 60 din paachi — ત્રણ ભાગ: વાવણી, ૩૦ દિવસ, ૬૦ દિવસ
fertilizers.benefits: Paan ane dakhal ni vadh karve. / Leaves and tillering growth.
fertilizers.precautions: Varasad pahela na nakho. Bheja jamin par na nakho. / Do not apply before rain.

fertilizers.name: DAP (Di-Ammonium Phosphate)
fertilizers.timing: Vavani vakhate muli khurak tarke / At sowing as basal dose
fertilizers.benefits: Mool ni vadh karve, pako mazhboot thay. / Root development and strong crop.
fertilizers.precautions: Choona (lime) sathe na bhelo. / Do not mix with lime.

fertilizers.name: MOP (Muriate of Potash)
fertilizers.timing: Vavani vakhate athava vibhajit khurak tarke / At sowing or split
fertilizers.benefits: Falangi gunvatta vadhare, dushkal sahmna shakti aape. / Improves fruit quality and drought tolerance.
fertilizers.precautions: Vadhu nakhe nai — namakna zararne nuksaan thay. / Avoid excess — can cause salt injury.

fertilizers.name: NPK 10-26-26
fertilizers.timing: Vavani vakhate muli dose tarke / At sowing as basal dose
fertilizers.benefits: Santulit poshan aape — saras utpadan. / Balanced nutrition for good yield.
fertilizers.precautions: Bhija jamin par na nakho. / Do not apply on wet soil.

fertilizers.name: NPK 12-32-16
fertilizers.timing: Vavani vakhate muli dose tarke / At sowing as basal dose
fertilizers.benefits: Shuruaatni vadh saari thay. / Good initial crop establishment.
fertilizers.precautions: Jamin ma poshan tapas kari nakho. / Check soil nutrient status before use.

fertilizers.name: SSP (Single Super Phosphate)
fertilizers.timing: Vavani pahela nakho / Apply before sowing
fertilizers.benefits: Moongfali-eranda mate khub upayogi. Gandhak pan male. / Very useful for groundnut-castor. Provides sulphur.
fertilizers.precautions: Sukhi jagaye rakhho. / Store in dry place.

fertilizers.name: Vermicompost
fertilizers.application_method: Soil incorporation before sowing (jamin ma ekatrith)
fertilizers.timing: Vavani na 2-3 aathvadiya pahela / 2-3 weeks before sowing
fertilizers.benefits: Jamin ni gunavatta sudharase, paani rokavana shakti vadhe. / Improves soil quality and water retention.
fertilizers.precautions: Puri sadiyu hoy tyare upyog karo. / Ensure fully composted before use.

fertilizers.name: Neem Cake
fertilizers.timing: Vavani na 2-3 aathvadiya pahela / 2-3 weeks before sowing
fertilizers.benefits: Jamin na kida ane suttara rooke. Dhimaa utpadaa nitrogenno srot. / Controls soil pests and nematodes. Slow nitrogen release.
fertilizers.precautions: Beej sathe seedha sansarg na karo. / Avoid direct contact with seeds.

fertilizers.name: Zinc Sulphate
fertilizers.timing: Muli dose ya paheli pani sathe / Basal or first irrigation
fertilizers.benefits: Zinc ni kami dur kare — Gujarat ni jamin ma zinc ochu hoy che. / Corrects zinc deficiency common in Gujarat soils.
fertilizers.precautions: Phosphatic khatar sathe ghol ma na bhelo. / Do not mix with phosphatic fertilizers.

fertilizers.name: Potassium Nitrate
fertilizers.application_method: Fertigation or foliar spray (Drip sathe ya paan par)
fertilizers.timing: Fal aavva ni avastha ma / At fruit development stage
fertilizers.benefits: Falangi rang, kad ane shelf life vadhare. Kesar aam mate khub saras. / Improves fruit color and size. Excellent for Kesar mango.
fertilizers.precautions: Jwalnshil padartho thi dur rakhho. / Keep away from combustible materials.
